newsitem.title: USA: Microware Systems sees strong fiscal Q4.
newsitem.headline: Microware Systems sees strong fiscal Q4.

text.p: Microware Systems Corp said Thursday it was disappointed with its third quarter results but looked forward to a strong fourth quarter.
It said it was encouraged by "major design wins announced during the quarter based on our OS-9 software solution."

"We also anticipate announcing important design wins in the wireless personal communications, embedded Internet, and digital television markets with our customers in the near future," said President Ken Kaplan.
"We are seeing a surge of activity in the wireless products area," Kaplan said, "and we expect continued growth in our other vertical markets."
The software company today reported a loss of $615,000 for the third quarter, ended December 31, compared with a year-ago profit of $316,000. Revenues rose to $5.9 million from $5.7 million.
Shares in the company were up 3/4 to 13-1/4.
